reason: I drive down to Jbeil every Saturday and fill the boot, it is my outing and I pick everything myself. I don't need someone else to shop for me, and I would not trust a list over WhatsApp to come back the way I want it.
objection: Sending a list the night before on WhatsApp is a hassle, and I would still be doing my Saturday shop anyway, so I would be paying a bag fee for something I already do.
would_change_my_mind: If it were free for the first few months and I could just say 'same as last time' with no deadline, and I saw a neighbour I know had used it and was happy.
